title: Establish Subsystem Architecture Template D5P0-SSD980-Z with Macrium Reflect Backup Definition Inventory
author: Rolf, Workspace_AI Engine
description: Establishes a dedicated multi-boot OS subsystem template for D5P0-SSD980-Z (and sibling boot volumes), modeled on the HaSSD06 subsystem architecture, containing Macrium Reflect backup XML definitions, execution tools, and an interactive inventory explorer.
